item.title: Sampling Normal Random Variables
item.description: Knitting fractal surfaces out of normals For the banner above, we use a spectral synthesis technique developed in ???, based on the theory by Z. Gelbaum in ???. In short, by creating an appropriately weighted random sum of eigenfunctions of a region - in this case, a sphere - The algorithm Box-Muller transform The algorithm Polar form of Box-Muller The algorithm // returns a gaussian random function with the given mean and stdev.
